items.title: Paper invented in China
items.description: Cai Lun refines papermaking using bark, hemp, and rags during the Han dynasty

items.title: Telephone patented
items.description: Bell transmits the human voice over wire

items.title: Email invented
items.description: Ray Tomlinson sends the first network email, introducing the @ symbol

fact: These inventions transformed how humans share information, from paper and print to a global network connecting billions of devices.
